༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dril bu lugs kyi sgrub thabs bde chen snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i

< dril bu lugs kyi > sgrub thabs bde chen snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ / oṃ swā sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bde chen snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpa' bo che/ /gdul dka' 'dul la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rab zab lus dkyil sgrub thabs ni/ /mchog tu gsal ba spro bar bya/ /'dir grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba slob dpon rdo rje dril bu'i man ngag zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa'i thabs ni/ 'od gsal lam khyer dang 'brel ba'i gnyid las yang dag par ldang ba na/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis cang te'u'i sgra rtsa sngags kyi dbyangs dang bcas te bskul bas/ 'od gsal las yang dag par sad de he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur langs par bsam mo/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pas khrus kyang bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams kyang ji ltar rigs par bya'o/ /de nas nyams su blang ba'i rnal 'byor dngos la/ sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor te gsum las/ dang po la yang gsum ste/ rdzas byin gyis brlab pa/ rten byin gyis brlab pa/ las byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni dam rdzas kyi ril bu za ba'am/ dam rdzas btab pa'i chang la 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod pas myang*/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la nang mchod dngos su bsham pa med na byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni brjod mi dgos la/ 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsi myangs bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu tshogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i dpal mchog dang po'i yi ge hūṃ sngo skya/

ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus nang thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum dbyings su sbyangs te/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur/ 'di la lū nag sogs dang mthun par dag pa gsum yang don tshang mod/ gzhung las des sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyang ngo zhes gsungs pas na/ 'ga' zhig so sor phral nas dag pa gsum dang sbyor bar mdzad pa las/ lo chung sogs rang bzhin byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ sgo gsum byin gyis rlabs pa zhes gnyis su bsdus te 'chad pa legs par snang ngo*/ /gsum pa ni/ hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rnams ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir song ste/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa dbyer ma mchis pa lus dkyil dang bcas shing*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs te 'od zer rnams rang gi snying gar thim/ gang drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyis/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pādyaṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai dyaṃ/ shapta zhes sbyar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun bshags bya/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag gi lus 'bul bar bgyi'o/ / zhes bdag nyid phul/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ sku rdo rje bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor/ gsung rdo rje bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ thugs rdo rje rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de'i dang po la yang gsum ste/ rags pa yongs rdzogs dang*/ phra ba yongs rdzogs dang*/ ye shes yongs rdzogs so/ /dang po la/ thun mong du sbyong ba/ snod sbyong ba/ bcud sbyong ba ste gsum mo/ /dang bo ni/ tshogs zhing 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu/ rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs te bdag nyid la thim/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis rgyud gang bar gyur/ 'di chos sku lam byed thun mong ba ste 'chi srid sbyong byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gdod ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig de nyid la gsal bar gyur pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ skra sen pags pa rus pa'i tshigs rnams bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ bu ga brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad/ lus 'doms gang gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni bde ba chen po/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa ni sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ dbang po rnams ni me long la sogs brgyan rnams kyi bdag nyid do/ / gsum pa ni/ de ltar gyur pa'i bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka ind+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer can gyi sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sku lus dang mtshungs par char sprin gsar pa'i mdog can cher khros shing 'jigs su rung ba/

g.yon zhal ljang khu dpa' ba'i nyams can/ rgyab zhal dmar po 'dzum zhing chags pa/ g.yas zhal ser po sgeg cing bzhad pa/ zhal re re la dmar zhing bkra la rab tu 'khrugs pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ zhal thams cad kyang rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa rgyangs te 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis stod g.yogs su bsnams pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gugadrug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwaṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i nu ma'i steng dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa'i steng nas brdzis pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris grol ba/ ral pa'i cod pan thor tshugs bcings pa'i rtse mor 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i nor bu dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa dang*/ ral pa'i mdun ngos la sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la rgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal can/ spyi bor nor bu dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ phyag gdub dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ dpung gdub dang*/ 'og pag las dpyangs pa dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas pa'i ska rags la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ / snying rjes rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yon pas bdud sogs gdug pa can gyi khrag dang*/ mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin zhing*/ yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pas/ rgyab zhal du stob pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs kun rnam par gnon zhing sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems can thams cad bsdigs par mdzad pa/ gcer bu ba spu langs shing*/ dbu skra sil bur grol ba/ nu ma mkhrang zhing rgyas la lang tsho la bab pa/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab yum 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang bde ba chen po dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid can dus mtha'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / 'di ni longs sku lam byed thun mong ba dang bar do sbyor byed de/ de yan chod thun mong ma yin pa'i sprul sku lam byed yin no/ / yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dkar po las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ byāṃ las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po rtse mor byāṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' khams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥdamar pos las padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ dyāṃ las byung ba'i ze'u 'bru dkar po rtse mor dyāṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang yum gyi mgrin par zla ba la oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi thugs ka dang yum gyi dpral par zla gdan la oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇ+ṇi nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

yab kyi mgrin pa dang yum gyi lte bar nyi ma la/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la samba raṃ swāhā/ yab kyi dpral pa dang yum gyi thugs kar nyi gdan la/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags rnams kha dog dmar po g.yon skor du gnas shing 'od zer 'phro ba/ yab yum phan tshun zhal sbyor ba na sngags dang 'od zer sbyor bas kyang 'khyud oṃ āḥhūṃ snyoms par bzhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyas shing brtan par gyur/ de dag ni bde ba chen po'i sku lam du byed pa dang*/ bar srid chags sdang dang srid pas skye srid la phyogs pa sbyong byed do/ /'di ni gzhung las/ kha sbyor phyi nyid legs shes pas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ phyi dkyil gyi mngon byang lnga'i dod yin la/ lo tsā ba gzhan gyi man ngag la zhal shes su bzhugs shing*/ bod kyi grub thob pu rangs lo chung dang*/ rgya gar gyi mkhas grub chen po kha chen shākya shrī'i lugs las shin tu gsal bar 'byung ba yin te/ ma chad pa gal che'o/ /gnyis pa phra ba yongs rdzogs ni/ de ltar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan pas rkyen du gyur te/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gnyug ma'i lha tshogs mngon du gyur par bzhengs pa ni/ rtsa la la na dang*/ rā sa na'i 'khor dang bcas shing*/ lte ba'i aṃ gi yi ge bcud dang ldan pa'i rtsa a wa dhu tī ni rdo rje phag mo dang*/ snying ga'i dbus kyi gzhom du med pa'i thig le hūṃ gi rnam pa yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam kha ba 'dzag pa lta bur gnas pa ni/ dpal he ru ka ste/ sku mdog mthing nag sngo ljang dmar ser zhal/ /rdo rje dril bu glang lpags ḍā ma ru/ /dgra sta gri gug rtse gsum kha ṭwāṃ ga /thod khrag zhags pa tshangs mgo gdong bzhi 'dzin/ / g.yas brkyang pad nyer 'jigs byed dus mtshan brdzis/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar mo gri gug thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin/

/gnyis ka'ang me dpung dbus na rgyan dang bcas/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang skor rtsa 'dab brgyad las/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba dang bcas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du māṃ las mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du tāṃ las lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu pāṃ las dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor laṃ las gzugs can ma ser mo ste bzhi char yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon par rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga dang bcas shing*/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer mo lang tsho la bab cing bha ga dang nu 'bur mtho la bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / mtshams bzhir gnas shing bdud rtsi 'bab pa mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi ni bum pa bzhi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng ka pā la byang chub sems kyis gang ba dang bcas par gyur/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ pu dza o a go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la ka hi pre gṛ sau su na su ma ku ste yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur/ spyi bo pulli rā ma la ya ra khanḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ /spyi gtsug dza landha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang*/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna g.yas pa o ṭi ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag ma arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon pa go dha wa rar su ra bī ri dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus rasmi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang ling ga'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la bar rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po ste mkha' la spyod pa'o/

/mchan khung gnyis kā ma rū par aṃ ka ri dang e ra pa tī nu ma gnyis o trer rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang*/ chang 'thung ma/ kha ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang shya ma de wī/ mgrin pa laṃ pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang*/ shin tu bzang mo/ snying ga kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ 'dom par hi ma la yar mig mi bzang kha gā na na te gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po ste sa la spyod pa'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇḍa ro hi/ brla gnyis so so raṣtar rta mgrin dang shauṇḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su warṇ+ṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i cho ga ma/ rkang sor brgyad na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis sindhur padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku yi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po ste sa 'og tu spyod pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba he ru ka dang mtshungs pa ste/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang thod pa'i cod pan dang mgo bo'i phreng ba dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ stag lpags gsar pa'i smad dkris can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi po thams cad ni rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba/ rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa ste/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa skra grol ba phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi do shal dang ldan pa/

byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /snying ga'i phyi skor gyi rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin hūṃ brgyad sgo mtshams gnas pa'i ma mo brgyad du gyur pa ni/ shar du khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lho gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ brgyad ka yang drag mo chen mo cher khros pa/ ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams 'joms par mdzad pa mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis nas bzhugs pa'

ོ'i bar snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i skabs bzhin las/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad dpral par rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ / de dag ni thun mong ma yin pa'i longs sku lam byed dang*/ thun mong pa'i sprul sku lam byed dang skye ba dngos sbyong byed do/ /gsum pa ye shes yongs rdzogs ni/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dran pa yin te/ de yang*/ gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba/ /tshandho mngon du gyur pa ste/ /nye ba'i tshandho sbyangs dka' ba/ /'du ba ring du song ba ste/ /nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros nyid/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /shrī he ru ka'i gzhung du spyod/ /'di ni nang gi bdag nyid can/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi brda yi skad/ /bu la sogs pa ci gsungs pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas/ /lus rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni dpa' bo blo gros ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po laṅka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni sa bsrung ma'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni su ra bhakṣi'o/

/ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs lha mo'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni rab tu bzang mo'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta'i rna ba ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni bya gdong ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni khaṇḍa ro hi'o/ /chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni sho ṇḍi ni'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rab tu dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor los bsgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang de rnams nyid kyi rnam par dag pa can no/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khā gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams srung ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa spong ba ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ / zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i chos sku lam du byed pa ste/ sems kyi mthu yongs su rdzogs pa sbyong ngo*/ /mal lo nas brgyud pa'i man ngag las/ sgom mi nus pa dang brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag la yi ge dang rtsa khams tsam bsgoms pas chog par bzhed cing*/ lha so bdun byang phyogs so bdun du dag go zhes pa tsam las so so nas dag dran mi dgos so gsung mod/ 'on kyang las dang po pas ni sngar bshad pa kho na bya bar rigs so/

/gnyis pa byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ skad cig rnam pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ go cha dgod pa dang*/ ye shes pa bsre ba'o/ /dang po ni pho nya gsum bsre ba dran par byas te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wā ka tsitta badzra swā bha wa atma ko3 haṃ/ de kho na nyid kyi ye shes kyis rgyas btab ste/ oṃ badzra shuddha sarba dharma badzra shuddho3 haṃ/ sngags 'di gnyis ka lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad do/ /spyi gtsug tu swāhā hūṃ dmar po padma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral pa hreṃ hreṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsanḍi ka'i ngo bo ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma la zla ba'i gdan dang*/ gzhan rnams la nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /de ltar go cha'i yi ge bcu gnyis grub pa na/ yab kyi gnas rnams su yum drug yum gyi gnas rnams su'ang yab drug gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar gyur/ sgrub thabs 'di ni spros pa la mngon par dga' ba ma yin pa'i don du gsungs pa gtso che bas/ go cha'i lha rnams yig 'bru'i rnam par dgod pa nyid gtso bor bzung ngo*/ /de dag las skad cig rnam pas ni mngal du rtsa khams rlung gsum rgyas pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i dus su sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa'i bde ba chen po dang*/ go cha bkod pas ni phung khams skye mched rnams 'phel ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshon la/

de la skad cig rnam pa'i sngags ni gzhan nas kha bskang ba ste/ 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs na med pas mdor bsdu ba'i tshe bor yang rung ba lta bur snang mod kyi/ 'di nyid kyi srol ka thams cad la yod cing*/ pham thing pa'i lugs kyi man ngag dang bcas na 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam 'di'i srog lta bu yin pas ma chad pa nges par gal che'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs re re bzhin yang lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par spyan drangs par gyur/ phaiṃ zhes brjod/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ oṃ yog shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang 'khyud rgya bya'o/ /des ni btsas pa nas lo bcu drug lon gyi bar sbyong zhing ye shes kun tu khyab pa mngon du byed pa'o/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor la yang gsum ste/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slar yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa dang bcas pa phaiṃ/ tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ rdo rje phag mo snying po rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pas/ ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/

/de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dgabade ba chen po'i rang bzhin du byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud de so so'i spyi bor 'khyil ba yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang*/ bde chen 'khor lo pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la thim/ 'dis ni rang rigs kyi bya ba la gnas pa sbyong zhing*/sangs rgyas nas khams gsum gyi dbang phyug tu ston pa lam du byed do// gnyis pa la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ sumbha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams dang*/ glo bur du lhags pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa byung bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du pā dyāṃ/ oṃ badzra puṣpe hūṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra ghanḍe ra ṇi sogs kyis byin phab/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod pa 'bul lo/ /snga phyi'i mchod pa 'di rnams la rgyas par na rig ma bcu drug gam/ nyer spyod 'dod yon sogs kyis mchod pa ci rigs pa mdzad pa'ang yod cing mi 'thad pa'ang ma yin mod/ spros pa chung ngur mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'di rnams la sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rnams kyang mdor bsdus su sbyar ba nyid 'tsham zhing*/ gzhung dang rgya bod snga ma rnams kyis dgongs pa'ang yin no/

/gnyis pa ni nang mchod/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang*/ /dril bu pa dang dga' ba'i rdo rje dang*/ /lus med rdo rje sau ri pa dang ni/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ /de ba purṇa shākya shrī dang*/ /spyi lhas seng ge dpal dang bya ru ba/ /byang sems 'bri lung pa dang yang rtse ba/ /bu ston chos rje rnams la= khyung lhas pa dang nor bzang rin chen dang*/ /bka' bzhi rin rgyal mkhyen rab mchog grub dang*/ /bkra shis dpal 'byor bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*/ /bkra shis rgyal mtshan rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ / zhes brgyud pa'i gtso bo kha che lugs ltar ro/ /sa lugs ni nag po pa'i lugs bzhin las/ ngor chen mus chen paṇa chen chos rjes brag dmar ba chen po/ rab gsal zla mgon/ rje grol mchog rdo ring pa rnams khyad par ro/ /'di la bla ma dam pa man chad brgyud pa sna tshogs ded pas chog go /lo chung lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang phag mo dril bu pa dza lan dha ri pa nag po spyod pa dge ba'i mgon po bhu ba pa rnam rgyal zhabs te lo pa nā ro pa ma na kā shrī ka na ka shrī bha danta ba lo chung smar chen po kyi ston dkon 'bar khams pa shag rdor lo tsā mchog ldan dpal ldan seng ge mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje 'dzam gling paṇa chen a mo gha pa bla chen grags rin nam mkha' tshul khrims chos kyi seng ge kun dga' gzhon nu/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros don grub legs pa rnams so/ /de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la 'bul lo/ /gsum pa ni mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang sngags bzhi kha sbyor sogs yid kyis dran par byas te/ lha rnams rjes chags kyi bde bas mchod par mos la/ rnam lnga 'dod skor dang bcas yi ge bdun pa lan lnga brjod/ a nu rā ga'i sngags kyis nga rgyal bzung zhing*/

'khyud rgya byed pa'o/ /gsum pa bstod pa ni/ cang te'u'i sgra dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ wī ri shā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpagni sanni bhā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭotka ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣta kā ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ parshu pā shi dya kha ṭwaṃ ga dha ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bya bhra dzi naṃ ba ra dha ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhu mp+rāndhā kā ra wa pū ṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yab kyi rkang brgya dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badzra wā rā hī baṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ārya a pa ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi dya shwa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha yā ba he mahā badzre hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra ā sa ni a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ba shaṃ kā re na tra bhra ma ṇe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha kra rā li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni ma ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzambha ni stambha ni mo ha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra bā rā hi ma hā yo gi kā me shwa ri kha ge hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yum gyi rkang brgyad brjod pa ste/ mchod bstod de dag ni yul la nye ba longs spyod pa sbyong zhing*/ ye shes kyi 'byor pa dpag tu med pa 'thob pa'i rgyu'o/ /gzhi 'bras kyi dag sbyor 'di dag ni bskyed pa'i rim pa kho na la cha tshang ba gcig gnas dgos pa'i phyir/ de tsam gyis rdzogs pa ni lugs 'di'i dgongs pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsung rdo rje bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ khyogs kyi bzlas pa dang spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gang rung gi dmigs pa gsal btab la/ dung chen gyi 'phreng ba blangs nas bzlas pa byed pa las spro na 'phreng ba'i sngags rdzogs par bzla ste/

lū yi pa dang 'dra'o/ /'on kyang 'dir ni de gtso mi che bas snying po dang nye snying tsam gyis chog shes par bya la/ de yang nā ro pa'i man ngag las/ yab yum gyi sngags kha sbyor lugs su bzla ba dang*/ gzhan rnams so sor bzla ba ste lugs gnyis yod pa las snga ma bzang ngo*/ /de yang*/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la sambha raṃ swāhā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ / oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yab kyi nye snying ngo*/ / oṃ sarba buddha ṭā ki ni ye badzra warṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi nye ba'i snying po'o/ /lte ba'i thig le las 'od zer spro ba dang*/ khams gsum po 'khor lo lnga'i lhar byas te slar bsdu ba/ dbugs 'gro 'ong der lhan cig gi dbu ma'i lam du 'jug pa dang*/ 'byung ba bsgoms nas bzla ba ni dam tshig gi bzlas pa'o/ /gsum pa thugs rdo rje rdzogs rim ni/ rim pa lnga las gang yang rung ba ste/ 'on kyang gzhung las/ sa bon dang bcas pa'i bdag byin rlabs sgom par bsngags so/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor la/ nye bar bsdu ba/ bsrung ba/ mchod pa/ spyod lam/ kha zas/ rjes chags/ gtor ma ste skabs 'dir bdun las/ dang po nyid bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ni/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ rang nyid la thim lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad rang gnas su 'od du zhu/ phyi dbyibs kyi sku yang de dag dang 'dres/ byang chub sems kyi thig ler gyur/ de nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim/ de la cung zad mnyam par bzhag/ slar yang rang dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog tu gyur/ gnyis pa bsrung ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ yab kyi snying khar oṃ ha nas shar ba ltar gyur gyi bar gong bzhin go cha gnyis bkod/ spyi bor la sogs pa'i gnas zhes pa nas/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur/ zhes go cha chen pos bsrung*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gsum pa mchod pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ phyi rol mchod pa dang*/ lag mchod la sogs pa ste/ tshes bcu'i mchod chog khungs ma rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ snang ba thams cad dpal he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs su blta ba'o/ /lnga pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ byin gyis rlabs te lus dkyil la mchod pa'i tshul du nang gi sbyin bsreg bya'o/ /drug pa rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rig ma dang mnyam par sgyur ba'i bde stong sgom pa'o/ /bdun pa gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ thun tha ma la'am/ thun re re zhing ngam/ nam phyed kyis dus na bya ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sha chang sogs dang ldan par bshams/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pā ya gṛhṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badzra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wā shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/

de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang gi shar du oṃ dkar po las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ ljang khu las sha chen gyi dwangs ma khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu aṃ dmar po las byang chub kyi sems aṃ gis mtshan pa/ lhor traṃ ser po las rakta trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ sngon po las dri chu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ mer laṃ dkar po las ba lang gi sha laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ bden bral du māṃ sngon po las khyi'i sha maṃ gyis mtshan la/ rlung du pāṃ dmar po las glang po'i sha paṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du tāṃ ljang khu las rta'i sha tāṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su baṃ dmar po las sha chen baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me 'bar bas rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba/ nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser gsal la dwangs par gyur pa'i steng thad du hūṃ yig las byung ba'i kha ṭwaṃ ga dkar po byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ mgo bo 'thur du lta ba/ de las bdud rtsi dkar po babs te/ der lhung pa g.yon skor du lan gsum dkrugs shing zhu bas/ dngul chu'i mdog can shin tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai ai au āṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa tha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha pa bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ /hūṃ sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha dang bcas pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phros/ rgya mtsho la sogs pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bkug cing*/ 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas pa rnams spyan drangs/

snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu/ de thams cad yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ yang rim pa ltar bdud rtsir zhu ba gtor ma la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum ste byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ / rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur/ de nas rkang pa mnan zhing gyen du blta/ zhes pa'i 'dug tshul dang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ phaiṃ ces brjod/ 'di la pheṃ dang phaiṃ dang phraiṃ dang pheṭa rnams gdam nga yin no/ / rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phyi rol phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba sogs srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yo ga shuddha lan gcigs ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ lan gsum/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ lag pa g.yon du ā li las zla ba/ g.yas su kā li las nyi ma/ dbus su hūṃ/ zla nyi hūṃ dang bcas yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje thal mor gyur/ gtor snod lags kyis blangs par mos la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig ma dang*/ des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /lha rnams gtor ma gsol ba la thugs dges pa dang ldan pa las ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra a ralli ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dri shya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin/ arghaṃ/ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/

srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/ khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzigs kyang*/ / mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chus rgyas sems la ni/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /'jig rten pa rnams la phul bar mos te/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta bi shā tsa unma da a pasmar ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da yaḥ i maṃ ba liṃ grihṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma sarba sidhi me pra ya tstshantu ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣtaṃ/ bhu dza tha pi wa tha/ dzi gha tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta yā/ sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ye sa ha yi ka bha bantu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ klu yi= gnod sbyin= srid po'i= 'byung po'i= yi dwags= sha za'i= smyo byed= brjed byed= mkha' 'gro'i= ma mo'i= ma lus pa ni thams cad dag / 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa srung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis mches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yogs bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /srungs mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/

/gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pas bstod cing 'dod don zhu/ yig brgya bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa= sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ yo ga shuddha 'i sngags rgya bya/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor pa rang nyid la thim/ smon lam gdab/ bkra shis brjod/ de ltar skabs 'dir rnal 'byor bdun dang*/ gong du bstan pa'i nyal ldang gnyis te/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor dgu yin la/ mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor gsum ste yongs gril bcu gnyis so/ /de dag las mngon rtogs kyi rim pa rkang grangs su brjod na/ dang po rten sbyang ba/ gnyis pa tshogs zhing mchod pa/ gsum pa bdag la bsdu ba/ bzhi pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ lnga pa phyi'i yab yum gsal 'debs pa/ drug pa rjes su chags pa/ bdun pa brten pa'i lha tshogs sgom pa/ brgyad pa dag pa dran pa/ dgu pa skad cig rnam pa/ bcu pa go cha rnam gnyis/ bcu gcig pa ye shes spyan 'dren/ bcu gnyis pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ bcu gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa/ bcu bzhi pa nye bar bsdu ba ste bskyed rim dngos la rim pa bcu bzhi/ bzlas pa dang rdzogs rim dang*/ sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum dang*/ thun mtshams rjes spyod lhag ma dgu ste/ yongs su gril bas don tshan nyer brgyad yin no/ /'di ni rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ gsang ba mchog gi dges pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog/'di ni rang byung bcom ldan dpa'/

/zhes pas/ phyi nang gi gtso bo yab yum dang*/ mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sdom pa'i yin zhes pas lugs kyi lha tshogs mdor bstan pa dang*/ rtsa bshad kyi rgyud mang por lus dkyil rgyas bshad mdzad pa rnams la brten te/ grub chen gyi yang dag par bsdus pa ste/ bskyed rim sgrub thabs su gtogs so cog la 'di bas zab pa med par grags la ches zab pa'ang yin no/ /de ltar na 'di ni kha che lugs su grags pa'i sgrub thabs la rtsa bar byas/ nā ro ta pa'i man ngag lugs gnyis kyi legs cha mtha' dag tshang bar byas pa ste/ tshig don dgos nges rnams ye nas ma chad pa dang*/ mi dgos pa cung zad kyang ma lhag pa dang*/ gzhung gi dgongs pa las ma 'khyogs pa dang*/ ngag 'don bde zhing 'tsham pa dang*/ tshig nyung ngus ngag sbyor gsal por bstan pas/ go don bshad pa gzhan la mi ltos pa ste yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /tshul 'di gsal byed mang na yang*/ /yon tan lnga ldan gzhan med pas/ /'dir 'bad don med ma yin te/ /dge des he ru kar gyur cig/dril bu lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs bde chen snying po zhes bya ba/ 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so drug pa la sbyar ba'o/ / zhus dag/maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bde chen snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 278--PAGE 279--PAGE 257-
